notes: D1 oracle is official Transport Canberra / CMET passenger light rail maps, HAND-TRANSCRIBED. Stations arrays are not generated from GTFS. H2 name-clash is against the public no-key static zip (bus-only, stale) plus live no-key GTFS-RT lightrail.pb. No stopIds in this file.
City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: TRAIN-like light rail only (R1). No buses, Rapid (R2–R10), coaches, or school services in the oracle.
Timezone Australia/Sydney HAS DST (AEDT/AEST). Do not copy Brisbane / Gold Coast no-DST.
One printed line: R1 Gungahlin – City. Passenger code R1 on interchange maps and region maps.

Locked inner-city printed name: Alinga Street (R1 route map hub bubble; Welcome aboard columns; CMET stop list Alinga Street, City). Not Civic, not City, not City Interchange, not Alinga St as a stop. TC page card title is 'Gungahlin to Civic map'; Gungahlin Interchange prints R1 to City. Civic/City are precinct/direction labels, not the stop lock.
14 open stops on the official R1 map. Woden / Stage 2A (Edinburgh Avenue, City South, Commonwealth Park) are not on that passenger map and are not passenger-open as of 27 Aug 2026. Not inserted.
EPIC and Racecourse locked from the R1 map (and). CMET HTML prints EPIC & Racecourse.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown is the passenger code R1. Public google_transit.zip has no R1 row. No stopIds in this file.
coverageGaps: Stage 2A City–Commonwealth Park not passenger-open (Built for CBR: construction to early 2027, regular services early 2028). Three new stops named on the project page, not on the R1 passenger map: Edinburgh Avenue, City South, Commonwealth Park. Not inserted.
Stage 2B Commonwealth Park–Woden not passenger-open (2028–2033). Not inserted.
City Interchange 20 July 2026 map shows R1 only to Dickson & Gungahlin; no LR platforms south of Alinga St.

Public static GTFS https://www.transport.act.gov.au/googletransit/google_transit.zip is bus-only (all route_type=3), calendar ended 2025-07-04, no R1 / no light-rail parents. MyWay+ replacement https://transport.api.act.gov.au/gtfs/data/gtfs/v2/google_transit.zip requires basic auth.
Region maps (Gungahlin / Inner north / Inner south / Woden / network) are mixed bus+LR. Rapid R2–R10 and local buses out of v1.
PDF hex colours are legend metadata, not D1 print locks.
